about: C9: what is removed from the environment of a frontier CLI child (judge/runner/run_judge.py frontier_env), so nothing can point the frontier CLI at the local gateway or swap its credentials or provider. sec-evals keeps its own copy of the list in evals/run.py (a harness file) and tests parity against a vendored copy of this file. Versioning: minor = a variable added; major = a variable removed or a rule changed.

rules.strip: every endpoint_vars and strip_vars entry is removed
rules.api_key_with_endpoint: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is also removed when any ANTHROPIC_* endpoint var was set (non-empty)
rules.gateway_host: any variable whose value contains SPARK_API_HOST is removed
